english.title: Use / erect apparatus to transmit / receive / record / reproduce sound / speech / images within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse or having first obtained the permission of Heathrow Airport Limited,

(A)_[erected]_

apparatus for the

(C)_[transmission]_
(D)_[receipt]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.9 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
